verdict.rationale: No OpenAPI or Swagger file was found: every common path returned 404 (probe-2). The evidence offers only adjacent machine-readable artifacts: a Postman quickstart for API v2, which implies an importable collection; an llms.txt index with .md versions of every docs page; and runtime configuration endpoints that describe workspace data shapes. missing for 10: a documented downloadable OpenAPI/equivalent spec file, explicit confirmation that the Postman collection is downloadable, and hands-on verification of any spec artifact.
